tool.help:
**Biomni: Analyze Calcium Imaging Data**
Analyze calcium imaging data to quantify neuronal activity metrics.
This function processes fluorescence microscopy images of GCaMP-labeled neurons to extract quantitative metrics of neuronal activity, including cell counts, event rates, decay times, and signal-to-noise ratios.
Parameters ---------- image_stack_path : str Path to the time-series stack of fluorescence microscopy images (TIFF format) output_dir : str, optional Directory to save output files (default: "./")
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the analysis steps and results
**Domain**: bioengineering **Function**: analyze_calcium_imaging_data
